claims.evidence: Photos show the keyboard front/controls and keys, but no proof of power-on, sound output, or full functionality of keys/buttons.
Witness photos show 'YAMAHA' branding on the base, but the specific model 'SX-600' is not readable/confirmed in the provided images.

risks.risk: Not actually the claimed model (SX-600) or different Yamaha variant, which changes market value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label/sticker (usually on the rear panel or underside) showing 'SX-600'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha electronic keyboard/arranger of unknown exact model, at the worst-case value for uncertain model.

risks.risk: Hidden non-working faults (dead keys, stuck buttons, faulty speaker, weak output, or intermittent power).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, volume/speaker output, and a full test: play across the full keyboard range and press several buttons/sliders while audio is audible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified working; treat as 'as-is' with potential faults (worst-case) until tested.

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear/damage not captured clearly (scratches, dents, missing knobs/buttons, worn keys).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: (1) both ends and corners, (2) top panel around buttons/sliders, (3) underside/ports, and (4) keybed/key tops for wear.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for used condition with possible cosmetic wear.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables, stand/manual) affecting usability and buyer cost.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (adapter model/label, sustain pedal, any cables/USB/MIDI leads, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing or not included accessories.

risks.risk: Connectivity/feature uncertainty (USB/MIDI, touch sensitivity, number of voices/speakers) impacting value.
risks.proof: A photo of the specs panel/menu screen after power-on showing voices/sounds and connectivity options, or a clear rear-panel ports photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case feature set for an unknown/untested unit.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the model label/sticker showing 'SX-600' (rear panel or underside).
Send a short power-on + audio test video: play keys across the full range and demonstrate several buttons/sliders while sound is audible.
Send close-up photos of any missing/damaged knobs/buttons and the key tops for wear.
Confirm included items: power adapter (show label), sustain pedal, and any cables/stand/manuals with photos.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Yamaha electronic keyboard, but the exact model (SX-600) and full working condition are not verifiable from the images. A power-on functional test and a readable model label are needed before pricing confidently.
